subject: history
concept: Understanding that ancient civilizations built impressive structures using early tools and teamwork
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple structure using basic materials, discussing the teamwork and planning it takes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an ancient structure to the civilization that built it
exercise.abstract: Student explains why building a large ancient structure required cooperation and planning

misconception_flags: assumes large ancient structures were built quickly or by only one or two people

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
